# Gtk4 snapshot via cgo + GskCairoRenderer. Skips when gtk4 dev libs
# (pkg-config gtk4) are unavailable.

[!exec:go] skip 'go toolchain required'
[!exec:pkg-config] skip 'pkg-config required'
[!display] skip 'gtk4 snapshot needs an X11/Wayland display (headless CI)'

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
exists app.sngl.snapshots/initial.png

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=
sngl test --platform=gtk4 app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

output { go { gtk4 } }

component greeter {
    var name = "world"
    text(value=name)
}

func testGreeterSnapshot(t Test, c greeter) {
    t.snapshot("initial")
}
